## Vortex Announcements Publisher
Receives authenticated publish/cancel requests from Abilio and atomically replaces the feed served at https://nodemation.nforensic.site/vortex/latest.json via the vortex-publisher sidecar (plane/compose.yml).

**Env vars (plane/.env):** VORTEX_PUBLISH_TOKEN — Abilio webhook token (X-Vortex-Publish-Token). VORTEX_SIDECAR_TOKEN — n8n-to-sidecar token (X-Publisher-Token).

Fails closed: missing env vars yield 500 server_misconfigured. This workflow never writes files itself — the sidecar owns the feed volume and provides idempotency and atomic replacement. Expiry (already_expired) is enforced by the sidecar for new operations only — replays of recorded keys return their recorded response.
